title: Four-bit equality polynomial coefficients
statement: On the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^4$, define $P(x)=-3+\sum_{0\le j<k<4}x_jx_k$. For every subset $S\subseteq\{0,1,2,3\}$, the Fourier coefficient of $P$ at $S$ is $-3$ if $S$ is empty, $1$ if $S$ has two elements, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the four coordinate indices
